rows.episode_title: Save the Porcupine! / Save the Runaway Egg!
rows.synopsis: A porcupine gets stuck in a tight spot, and a mama chicken's precious egg rolls away.
rows.situation: Zuri's propeller will not stay on and her frustration boils over, and the team shows a porcupine stuck between two trees how to let big feelings flow with slow breathing, wiggles, and a push-pull save that gets him home for dinner before dark.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x01 Porcupine, title-matched (Zuri's propeller frustration, breathe in breathe out nice and slow song, porcupine stuck by his quills). No starter topic fits a big-feelings rescue; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Porcupine! / Save the Runaway Egg!
rows.synopsis: A porcupine gets stuck in a tight spot, and a mama chicken's precious egg rolls away.
rows.situation: A mama chicken refuses Tate's help because he is a snake, and when her runaway egg gets beyond Izzy and Zuri's reach, her apology and the team-of-three save teach her to never judge a creature for being the creature they are.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x01 Runaway Egg, title-matched (no snakes that's all the end, egg stuck by a branch, Mama Chicken's judge-no-creature apology). No starter topic fits an inclusion story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Screaming Goat! / Help the Wild Culpeo!
rows.synopsis: A dwarf goat has a serious case of the yelps, and an energetic fox is eager to play with a delicate butterfly.
rows.situation: Zuri is hoppin' mad about a blocked view and lets it out in shouts, and a dwarf goat in Nigeria is screaming for the same reason, so the team models the fix of telling someone what is wrong instead of yelling it.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x10 Screaming Goat, title-matched (Zuri blocked view, screaming mad, after sighin' stompin' yellin' maybe try just tellin' us what's wrong, Zuma Rock view). No starter topic fits a feelings-and-words story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Screaming Goat! / Help the Wild Culpeo!
rows.synopsis: A dwarf goat has a serious case of the yelps, and an energetic fox is eager to play with a delicate butterfly.
rows.situation: A wild culpeo in Ecuador only wants to play with a shy blue morpho butterfly but keeps scaring her off with rough games, and quiet Tate helps everyone discover that sitting still and playing gently is its own way to make a friend.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x10 Wild Culpeo, title-matched (Bumper Wheels too rough for Tate, running and jumping may be too rough for the butterfly, sitting quietly on the ground, gentle ride on her nose). No starter topic fits a gentle-play story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Chinchilla! / Help the Golden Spider?
rows.synopsis: A chinchilla needs rescuing from a tricky spot, and a spider wants to spin a web that'll wow.
rows.situation: Zuri tells her friends she does not like her feet touched and they save her a different way, then the whole team realizes a stranded chinchilla is dodging rescue for the same reason, so they build a rock bridge that lets her do it herself.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x11 Chinchilla, title-matched (I don't like having my feet touched, it's just the way I am, chinchilla dodges the snake squeeze, rockin' rock bridge, chinchilla fist bump). No starter topic fits a body-boundaries story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Chinchilla! / Help the Golden Spider?
rows.synopsis: A chinchilla needs rescuing from a tricky spot, and a spider wants to spin a web that'll wow.
rows.situation: A young golden orb-weaver in Thailand races to finish her first web before her dad gets home and keeps watching it fall apart, and Izzy, who sped through the Jetcar and forgot wings and friends, teaches her the fix he just learned: take a breath, slow down, connect the pieces.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x11 Golden Spider, title-matched (first web ever woven, dad will be proud, moving so fast it made us dizzy, forgot to connect the strands, I knew you could do it). No starter topic fits a slow-down-and-focus story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Caribbean Crab! / Save the Bighorn Sheep!
rows.synopsis: A crab's colorful castle risks getting washed away, and two sibling sheep fight over who goes first.
rows.situation: Izzy's beloved block city crashes down and so does a crab's sandcastle in Jamaica, and both are ready to quit building forever until a friend who lost the very same thing listens first, then shows them how to build again, better and farther from the waves.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x12 Caribbean Crab, title-matched (New Block City ruined, I do feel mad and sad, it helped to talk, build something better than ever before, rebuilt New Block City). No starter topic fits a disappointment-and-rebuilding story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Caribbean Crab! / Save the Bighorn Sheep!
rows.synopsis: A crab's colorful castle risks getting washed away, and two sibling sheep fight over who goes first.
rows.situation: Two bighorn sheep in the Canadian Rockies each demand to be first into the lake and tangle their horns over it, while Zuri and Tate tangle over a Jetcar propeller, until both pairs land on the answer of doing it together so everyone wins.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x12 Bighorn Sheep, title-matched (me first, no me, tangled horns, jump together and both of you win, both first to jump in the lake). No starter topic fits a taking-turns story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Red Squirrel! / Help the Dung Beetle!
rows.synopsis: A squirrel loses track of a buried treat, and a beetle battles a blowfly over a ball of dung.
rows.situation: A red squirrel in the Scottish Woodlands has buried ten acorns somewhere and cannot remember where, with winter coming, and Zuri's own lost steering wheel supplies the fix: stop, think back, and retrace your steps until the acorns turn up.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x13 Red Squirrel, title-matched (ten acorns buried, winter is here, retrace your steps song, steering wheel in the doll clothes, all ten found). No starter topic fits a lost-and-found story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Red Squirrel! / Help the Dung Beetle!
rows.synopsis: A squirrel loses track of a buried treat, and a beetle battles a blowfly over a ball of dung.
rows.situation: A dung beetle and a blowfly in the Kalahari both claim the same ball of dung until the fight rolls it away from everybody, and Zuri and Izzy, mid-tug-of-war over a carrot, show the simpler answer: split it and share it with both families.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x13 Dung Beetle, title-matched (no it's mine carrot fight, split it in half, dung rolls away, share this among both our families, family dinner invites). No starter topic fits a sharing story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Mountain Lion! / Save the Baby Chick!
rows.synopsis: A mountain lion aims a little too high for his size, and a hungry chick struggles to be seen and heard.
rows.situation: A little mountain lion keeps following his big brother up rocks too big for him, and Zuri, caught copying Izzy, learns alongside him that only you can be you and that being little can be exactly the right size for the job.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x02 Mountain Lion, title-matched (Zuri copying Izzy's super-mega-awesome, cub stuck twice, little enough to squeeze through). No starter topic fits a be-yourself story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Mountain Lion! / Save the Baby Chick!
rows.synopsis: A mountain lion aims a little too high for his size, and a hungry chick struggles to be seen and heard.
rows.situation: A hungry baby chick is too quiet to be heard at the crowded feeder, and quiet Tate shows her that a power pose and speaking up can get your needs met without changing who you are.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x02 Baby Chick, title-matched (Tate trying to excuse me, up the volume and speak up song, power pose, meep meep meep heard at last). No starter topic fits a speak-up story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Woodpecker! / Save the Salmon!
rows.synopsis: A woodpecker can't shake free from a tree, and a young salmon needs some uplifting words to make it upstream.
rows.situation: A woodpecker refuses every offer of help with her beak stuck in a tree, and Zuri, who just pulled her own wheel free, finds the teamwork that respects independence: cheering her on with a beat until she does it herself.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x03 Woodpecker, title-matched (Zuri working together me and me and me, help her do it herself, lo hice). No starter topic fits an independence story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Woodpecker! / Save the Salmon!
rows.synopsis: A woodpecker can't shake free from a tree, and a young salmon needs some uplifting words to make it upstream.
rows.situation: A little salmon decides he is not cut out to be a salmon when the upstream swim beats him, until Tate, who stretched with grit to reach the walkie-phone, shows him that keeping on and showing some grit gets him home to his family.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x03 Salmon, title-matched (never say never, show some grit song, I'll never make it upstream, family reunion). No starter topic fits a perseverance story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Hedgehog! / Save the Hippo!
rows.synopsis: A hedgehog becomes a "wedged-hog," and a hippo's cooldown turns into a muddy mess.
rows.situation: Each Wonder Pet insists its own way will free a hedgehog wedged in a log, and the bickering nearly wrecks the rescue until they combine Izzy's bump, Tate's twist, and Zuri's wiggle, discovering that all three different ways together are what works.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x04 Hedgehog, title-matched (wedged-hog, bump twist wiggle, puppy shaking the log, all three ideas save the day). No starter topic fits a teamwork story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Hedgehog! / Save the Hippo!
rows.synopsis: A hedgehog becomes a "wedged-hog," and a hippo's cooldown turns into a muddy mess.
rows.situation: Tate guards his freshly cleaned, shiny scales from the mud, then jumps in anyway when his friends and a stuck hippo need him, and finds the mucky pool he dreaded is the coolest place to be.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x04 Hippo, title-matched (my scales are so shiny, cool mud in Serengeti, vine strings pull, best part about getting clean is getting dirty again). No starter topic fits the story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Peacock! / Save the Woolly Mammoth!
rows.synopsis: A peacock questions his dancing abilities, and a woolly mammoth gets trapped on a chunk of ice.
rows.situation: A peacock with no tail feathers yet fears he cannot dance on the big night, and Izzy, wobbling without his lost sneaker, learns the same lesson he then passes on: sneakers do not make the Wonder Pet and feathers do not make the dancer.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x05 Peacock, title-matched (late plumer, fake flower tail fails, the clothes you wear song, chalo nacho dance). Topics: dance-night story fits Music & dance.

rows.episode_title: Help the Peacock! / Save the Woolly Mammoth!
rows.synopsis: A peacock questions his dancing abilities, and a woolly mammoth gets trapped on a chunk of ice.
rows.situation: Tate wonders if he could ever have anything in common with a woolly mammoth from a museum diorama, and a game of Tate Says finds the answer as the baby mammoth uses her trunk to swing free of the ice just like Tate swings from the ceiling.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x05 Woolly Mammoth, title-matched (what's it like to be you song, Tate Says game, trunk swing save). No starter topic fits a finding-common-ground story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save Tate? / Save the Song Birds!
rows.synopsis: A search for a souvenir lands Tate inside a sidewalk grate, and two song birds need to find their rhythm.
rows.situation: Tate's treasured souvenir bracelet is lost through a window during rough play, and retrieving it lands him in a grate where a pack rat named Pearl shows him that a special thing shared with a friend becomes more special, not less.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x06 Save Tate?, title-matched (souvenir wall dusting, hula-hooped bracelet out the window, Pearl the pack rat, bracelet as rescue rope, souvenir checkers). No starter topic fits a sharing-and-friendship story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save Tate? / Save the Song Birds!
rows.synopsis: A search for a souvenir lands Tate inside a sidewalk grate, and two song birds need to find their rhythm.
rows.situation: A robin and a fairy wren in London sing over each other so loudly that nobody wants to listen, and after the Wonder Pets stop competing over Jetcar parts and start collaborating, the two birds discover their songs are better in harmony than in contest.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x06 Song Birds, title-matched (competing songs, collaborate song, singing in harmony finale). Topics: singing-centered story fits Music & dance.

rows.episode_title: Help the Bear Cub! / Save the Sad Sumi-e Frog!
rows.synopsis: A bear cub would rather play all day than go to bed, and a painted frog could use some cheering up.
rows.situation: A bear cub in Romania refuses bedtime and hibernation because the fun is too good to stop, and Zuri, who swears she is not tired either, romps alongside him until both yawn and admit that rest now means energy for more fun-tivities in spring.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x07 Bear Cub, title-matched (not ready for bed, fun-tivities romp, kind of a teensy-weensy bit tired, bedtime snack broccoli). No starter topic fits a bedtime-resistance story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Bear Cub! / Save the Sad Sumi-e Frog!
rows.synopsis: A bear cub would rather play all day than go to bed, and a painted frog could use some cheering up.
rows.situation: A frog inside a sumi-e painting cries at every goodbye, and once the team names his loneliness, Tate, who felt the same when his friends stepped out, paints him a friend to keep him company.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x07 Sumi-e Frog, title-matched (ribbit code, painted pond and lily pads, are you sad because you feel lonely, painted friend). No starter topic fits an art-and-loneliness story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Roly Poly! / Save Jack (and the Giant, Too)!
rows.synopsis: A lonely pill bug looks for a pal, and Jack goes on the run from a much (much) bigger kid.
rows.situation: A roly poly new to the garden has no one to roll with and feels too shy to approach a stick bug who seems nothing like him, until introductions and a combined game of roly-stickball turn two unlike bugs into new friends.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x08 Roly Poly, title-matched (just moved to this garden, too shy to say hi, roly-ball plus stickball equals roly-stickball). Topics: invented-game story fits Sports & games.

rows.episode_title: Save the Roly Poly! / Save Jack (and the Giant, Too)!
rows.synopsis: A lonely pill bug looks for a pal, and Jack goes on the run from a much (much) bigger kid.
rows.situation: Jack runs from a giant he is sure is terrifying and Zuri flees a dragonfly she is sure is a monster, but up close the fears shrink: the dragonfly just buzzes that way, the giant just wants someone to play stomp tag with, and stomping turns out to be how giants say hi.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x08 Jack and the Giant, title-matched (Zuri's dragonfly monster scare, giant tangled in vines, all that I want is to have fun and play, stomping means hi, tag game). Topics: Fairy Tale Land giant story fits Monsters & magic.

rows.episode_title: Save the Elephant! / Help the Little Hawk!
rows.synopsis: A thirsty elephant who's blind needs to find the watering hole, and a young hawk tries tackling an impressive move.
rows.situation: A blind elephant new to an animal sanctuary needs to find the watering hole, and when the search circles back lost, a small puppy who kept asking for an elephant ride turns out to be the guide, showing that help can come from the least likely friend.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x09 Elephant, title-matched (blind elephant feels with her trunk, team lost in the sanctuary, puppy guides from her back, feel my way so I can remember). No starter topic fits a help-and-guidance story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Elephant! / Help the Little Hawk!
rows.synopsis: A thirsty elephant who's blind needs to find the watering hole, and a young hawk tries tackling an impressive move.
rows.situation: A little hawk wants to fly with the Top Beaks but their soar-flip-loop flattens her, and Izzy, ready to quit his own trick, learns from Tate to break big hard things into small steps, then teaches her to soar, flip, and loop one step at a time.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 01x09 Little Hawk, title-matched (soar-flip-loop, this trick is way too tough, broken into smaller bits, step by step, welcome to the Top Beaks). No starter topic fits a learning-a-skill story; topics left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Theater Mouse! / Save the Origami Bunny!
rows.synopsis: A mouse learns there are no small parts in the play—even for small critters—and the trio constructs an origami boat for a paper bunny.
rows.situation: A theater mouse stuck playing a tree in a Broadway musical feels his small part makes him invisible, and when he skips his spot the whole show collapses, teaching him and a wheel-dodging Zuri that there are no small parts on a team.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e01 English, title-matched to catalog segment (everyone has big exciting parts except me, skipped tree collapses the Alice number, there are no small parts, Zuri's wheel-catching parallel). rows.episode_title: Help the Theater Mouse! / Save the Origami Bunny!
rows.synopsis: A mouse learns there are no small parts in the play—even for small critters—and the trio constructs an origami boat for a paper bunny.
rows.situation: A hungry origami bunny cannot cross the paper lake to her carrots, and after the paper swan proves too small a ride, the team folds the answer itself: an origami boat, made of the same paper this whole world is made of.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e01, title-matched (missing propeller folded from paper, swan ride fails, paper clouds, origami boat plus life vests, everything is made out of paper here). Topics: origami craft story fits none of the eight starter topics; left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Red Panda! / Help the Songbirds... Write a Song!
rows.synopsis: Friends come together when a red panda's paper lantern rips, and songbirds look to the trio for musical inspiration.
rows.situation: A red panda's very first Yuan Xiao lantern ends up stuck in a Chengdu tree with a hole and a dead candle, and a broken rainbow bracelet that Zuri's friends fixed better than new shows her the way: spare capes for patching and a firefly friend for the glow.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e10, title-matched to catalog segment (breeze blew the lantern into the trees, a cracked bead and a broken string, I feel so sad, lantern patched with capes, firefly as the light, most beautiful lantern that ever flew, brand-new friend). rows.episode_title: Help the Red Panda! / Help the Songbirds... Write a Song!
rows.segment_title: Help the Songbirds... Write a Song!
rows.synopsis: Friends come together when a red panda's paper lantern rips, and songbirds look to the trio for musical inspiration.
rows.situation: Two songbirds back to thank the Wonder Pets cannot agree whether their song should celebrate rescues, fun, or friends, and neither can the three Wonder Pets, until the Jetscreen shows them all three ideas are really one: teamwork.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e10, title-matched to catalog segment (we don't know where to start, rescues friends fun, we can't even pick one, everything has one thing in common, teamwork, write it together). Topics: a write-a-song story fits Music & dance.

rows.episode_title: Help the Dancing Fishies! / Save the Red Balloon!
rows.synopsis: The Wonder Pets bring harmony to an underwater dance battle, and a runaway balloon races through the city.
rows.situation: Puffer fish and jellyfish both claim the same glowing cove near Cuba for their very different dance styles, and after a seaweed dividing line drifts away, the two schools discover their fast jazzy puff and slow graceful sway mash into one new tune.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e11, title-matched to catalog segment (dance floor isn't big enough, which side is yours and where's the line, Zuri and Tate mash their JetSub building music, mash up your music and all dance to a new tune). Topics: the dance-off is the story, so Music & dance.

rows.episode_title: Help the Dancing Fishies! / Save the Red Balloon!
rows.synopsis: The Wonder Pets bring harmony to an underwater dance battle, and a runaway balloon races through the city.
rows.situation: Tallula's brand new birthday balloon blows away over New York City, and the chase collects Pizza Kitty with a pizza pan, Pearl with a reusable bag, and a Theater Mouse prop gag before the whole team, past and borrowed, catches it together.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e11, title-matched to catalog segment (a present she was thrilled to get, it was such a breezy windy day, instead of trying to catch it all alone let's do it together, you're all on the team today). rows.episode_title: Save the Scarecrow!
rows.synopsis: When a scarecrow isn't scary enough to fend off pumpkin-eating crows, the Wonder Pets have to save Halloween.
rows.situation: An adorable scarecrow cannot scare the crows chewing toward his pumpkin stage before the Great Halloween Dance Party, and after borrowing scare lessons from skeletons and a witch he saves the night his own way, by dancing like only he can do.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e12, title-matched to catalog single-story row (I'm too adorable, I never thought of asking for help here in Halloweenville, skeleton moves and witch cackle both come out adorable, dance-crow, I saved the pumpkin stage in my own adorable way). Topics: the dance party is the stake rather than the story's center, so no starter topic; left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Help the Holiday Hamster! / Save the Snowman!
rows.synopsis: A hamster is too excited to sleep on Christmas Eve, and the trio smells trouble when a snowman's carrot nose goes missing.
rows.situation: A hamster on Christmas Eve is too excited to sleep and too wired for rock-out sessions or counting bunny reindeer to help, so the Wonder Pets tell him the bedtime story they made up in the classroom, and a sleepy alaka-snooze spell does the rest.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e13, title-matched to catalog segment (fired up wired and wide awake, I can rock all night, hopping made things worse, bedtime story alaka-snooze alaka-snore, he fell asleep). rows.episode_title: Help the Holiday Hamster! / Save the Snowman!
rows.synopsis: A hamster is too excited to sleep on Christmas Eve, and the trio smells trouble when a snowman's carrot nose goes missing.
rows.situation: Zuri borrows Tate's lucky hat without asking, and a chipmunk borrows a snowman's carrot nose the same way, so the episode hands both of them the same fix: a real sorry, a returned treasure, and a celery board so nobody ends up left out of the fun.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e13, title-matched to catalog segment (I'm really sorry Tate I took it cause I was cold, ear warmers anyway, I plucked it off the snowman's face I didn't think he'd mind, taking something without asking isn't very nice, celery-board for the chipmunk). rows.episode_title: Help Pizza Kitty! / Save the Tropical Fishie!
rows.synopsis: The team learns that the perfect pizza is the one made with friends, and a little fish needs help getting to school on time.
rows.situation: Pizza Kitty sets out to make the Wonder Pets a thank-you pizza entirely alone and ends up wearing the dough, and Izzy, who built the Jetcar by himself that morning, shows him the purrfect pizza is the one you make together.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e02, title-matched to catalog segment (first pizza ever alone, sticky dough on head, I got this, teamwork pizza added to the menu, making it together is the best part). Topics: pizza-making story fits Food & cooking.

rows.episode_title: Help Pizza Kitty! / Save the Tropical Fishie!
rows.synopsis: The team learns that the perfect pizza is the one made with friends, and a little fish needs help getting to school on time.
rows.situation: A curious little tropical fishie keeps wandering off the path to fish school after every sparkly thing she passes, and the team, led by a fellow distracted wanderer in Zuri, learns to work with the wandering instead of against it by building a trail of shimmer.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e02, title-matched to catalog segment (lost fishie swimming the wrong way, follows crabs starfish and shells, Zuri distracted by shimmery art, art trail leads her to the Jetsub, fish school at last). rows.episode_title: Save the Sleeping Cutie! / Help the Dress-Up Bear!
rows.synopsis: The Wonder Pets must get a koala to bed before he sleepwalks into trouble, and the gang comes together to help a bear find the perfect outfit.
rows.situation: A koala sleepwalks away from his tree and straight toward wallabies, falling fruit, and a billabong while never waking up, and his best mate calls the Wonder Pets to steer the sleeping cutie safely home with a path of outback teamwork.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e03, title-matched to catalog segment (still asleep on a nice walk, wallabies hop over, falling giant fruit, eucalyptus sniff, whispered finale, never woke up). Topics: none of the eight fits a sleepwalking-safety story; left empty rather than forced.

rows.episode_title: Save the Sleeping Cutie! / Help the Dress-Up Bear!
rows.synopsis: The Wonder Pets must get a koala to bed before he sleepwalks into trouble, and the gang comes together to help a bear find the perfect outfit.
rows.situation: A jazzy paper bear invited to a fancy tea party tries every dress in the book and none of them feel like her, so she nearly skips the party until the team, dressed in what feels right for each of them, helps her see the right outfit is whatever makes her feel like herself.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e03, title-matched (fashion emergency, the poofy is a little goofy, tried every dress, these outfits look more like me, vest and bow tie, wear what makes you feel like you). Topics: none of the eight fits a be-yourself story; left empty rather than forced.

rows.synopsis: A baby kangaroo would rather stay in mama's pouch than venture outside, and a slimy slug seeks a game he can play with his friends.
rows.situation: A joey in Tasmania will not hop out of his mama's pouch where it is safe and snuggly, and a comfort object made to smell and feel like her gives him the courage to try the big outside world, one hop at a time.

rows.episode_title: Help the Wallabies! / Help the Slimy Slug!
rows.synopsis: A baby kangaroo would rather stay in mama's pouch than venture outside, and a slimy slug seeks a game he can play with his friends.
rows.situation: A slimy slug in the school garden fears his slime ruins every game with his bug friends, until Tate's pink-paint Jetcar and a slip and slime slide flip the story: the thing that made him different is exactly what only he can bring to playtime.

rows.episode_title: Here Comes Cousin Luca! / Help the Emperor Penguin... Fly!
rows.synopsis: The trio becomes a quartet for the day when Zuri's cousin pays a visit, and an emperor penguin tries to conquer flying.
rows.situation: Izzy's cousin Luca bursts in bursting to join the Wonder Pets but keeps hopping into every rescue alone, and one tangled pile later he learns the thing he was missing: being on a team means you never work alone.
rows.notes: Subtitle tier: SubtitleCat s02e05, title-matched to catalog segment (I did it myself, stole Izzy's rescue, all stuck on the awning, all that I've done is show everyone I'm no kind of Wonder Pet, bounce back up together). rows.episode_title: Here Comes Cousin Luca! / Help the Emperor Penguin... Fly!
